payload.text: The ADD-03 cover summary and operative Clause 2.5 disagree on the tie-in shutdown application. The cover says 'the Authority's acceptance' with applications 'within eight (8) Working Days of the date of this Addendum'. Clause 2.5 says a Network Operator letter, applied for 'not later than eight (8) Working Days before the Proposal Due Date'. These give different deadlines (forward from 10 November 2026 vs backward from the PDD) and different addressees. Plan to the earlier of the two deadlines and confirm with the Authority which one governs.

payload.short: 31.1(d) Ramp-Up deduction relief stated only in cover summary
payload.text: The ADD-03 cover summary says the new Unavailability Event (loss of treated effluent volume) applies 'with no deduction during the Ramp-Up Period'. Operative Clauses 5.1 and 5.2 add event 31.1(d) and extend the no-cure-period rule to it. A search of ADD-03 found no operative words excluding deductions during the Ramp-Up Period, and VOL-V 29.3's Ramp-Up relief covers Table 2-4 parameters only. There is insufficient evidence that a Ramp-Up exclusion for 31.1(d) is in force. Ask the Authority to clarify.
